name: integration-atlas-likec4-poc
description: LikeC4 demonstration generated from the shared integration catalog

scripts.validate: npm run generate:check && likec4 validate src --max-warnings 0
scripts.dev: npm run generate && likec4 serve src --port 3000
scripts.build: npm run generate && likec4 build src -o dist --use-hash-history --title 'Integration Atlas — LikeC4 demo'
scripts.test: likec4 export json src --pretty --skip-layout -o .likec4/model.json && python3 scripts/verify_model.py .likec4/model.json
